Prophecy: Gabriel Foretells the Birth and Mission of John
ProphecySummary: The angel Gabriel predicts to Zechariah that his wife Elizabeth shall bear a son named John, who will be great, filled with the Holy Spirit from his mother's womb, turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, and go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled: John was born to Zechariah and Elizabeth (Luke 1:57-66) and carried out the foretold ministry of turning many to the Lord and preparing the way.
RelatedPeople: Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist; Elizabeth; John the Baptist; Elijah
